0.notes: Stage 0 closed. Preregistration approved and tagged. Feasibility limitations are documented in docs/feasibility_findings.md and reports/stage_0_report.md.

A1.notes: Database pipeline completed. 32 schemes, 39,478 NAV observations, 6,192 NIFTY TRI observations. Alignment 99.574% among benchmark-covered schemes. Eight BSE-dependent schemes remain without historical TRI coverage.

A2.notes: Stage A2 completed. A2.1-A2.9 acceptance checks passed: 96 SQL metrics rows, 96 SQL/Pandas parity comparisons with zero failures, 5/5 known-series tests, 12/12 factsheet comparisons, deterministic exports, and no sanity-threshold flags across 32 schemes. Eight schemes remain without benchmark-relative metrics because historical BSE 100 TRI and BSE 500 TRI were unavailable. No benchmark substitution was made. The risk-free rate remains a constant 6% annual assumption. The inherited A1 pytest test-collection issue remains unresolved and is retained in human_pending.

A3.notes: Preregistered A3 analyses completed. 32-scheme CAPM, primary 12-fund Direct BH-FDR, persistence, 16-pair TER fee-gap, mandate rules, passive controls, monthly/NIFTY 500/5%/7% RF/leave-extremes sensitivities, and 20-day block bootstrap are reported in reports/stage_A3_report.md. Data quality recheck: 170 PASS, 0 WARN, 0 FAIL. R2 flags for HDFC Large Cap (max drawdown), Nippon India Flexi Cap (beta), and SBI MIDCAP (beta) were reviewed against September 2026 factsheets and contextualized with no mandate mismatch evidenced; flags remain in the audit output. R3 flags ICICI Prudential Flexi Cap pair 6 (0.372 pp residual vs 0.300 pp threshold); its factsheet distinguishes current BER from TER, but no five-year TER history is available to establish the cause. Results use approved estimated hybrid BSE benchmarks for eight records and 30-Sep-2026 point-in-time TER; all outputs remain provisional.

A4.notes: Stage A4 dashboard completed and human-verified. Final PBIX saved at dashboard/MF_Audit_Dashboard.pbix. Four pages reviewed: Method & Limitations, Scorecard, Risk & Rolling, and Cost Audit. Four page screenshots saved under dashboard/dashboard_imgs/ at approximately 1292x727 resolution; the original 1920x1080 screenshot specification was accepted as a documented deviation without upscaling. The dark institutional theme was also accepted as a design deviation. Data pack contains 11 CSVs; dashboard validator PASS with 0 warnings; six dashboard contract tests pass; full project suite passes 11 tests; A4 report records five-value cross-check at 5/5 exact matches. A3 analysis and results were not modified by A4.

decisions.survivorship_note: UNCLEAR: Five-code survivorship probe was inconclusive. Historical codes absent from the current master were identified, but historical retrieval and closure/merger status were not conclusively established.
decisions.bse_deviation_note: The preregistered BSE 100 TRI and BSE 500 TRI series were unavailable. A provisional estimated hybrid series using BSE price returns and the matching NIFTY TRI/price dividend wedge will be used as the primary provisional series. Matching NIFTY TRI will be used for sensitivity analysis. Original benchmark identities and scheme mappings remain unchanged. This is a documented methodological deviation, not an unchanged confirmatory implementation of the original benchmark specification.
decisions.bse_swap_rule: When actual BSE TRI becomes available, use it as primary, rerun affected analyses, and report estimated-versus-actual tracking differences.
decisions.mandate_audit_acceptance_note: The 16 scheme-level rows in results/mandate_audit.csv satisfy B2 acceptance. The 32 Direct/Regular rows in results/mandate_audit_plan_detail.csv are supporting scheme-plan detail and are not counted as 32 distinct funds.
